title: Banana Mod
description: This Adds some banana themed items so yeah :)
body:
I Added lots of new items (designed all my me) for my friend Banana and this mod balences strength and how you get them

You get them by finding the new Banana biome to get banana blocks, these banana blocks can be crafted into bananas or the secret super banana block that has a Banana hammer. bananas can be made into all tools (even the hoe). This took me 2 days.




Made In MCreator
